scenario.shared_setting: Four adults share a rented HDB flat with one kitchen. In the early evening, a persistent cooking aroma is noticeable in the kitchen and adjoining common area. Shared preparation space and ordinary shared utensils are in use. The household has not established rules about ventilation or utensil separation.
